items.title: Jason Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: When it came to snare drum, I had a teacher named David DeGroot

ctx.x: I want to say it was a week, maybe a week and a half. No, I think it was a week, because I seem to remember it was a weekend where I went to do the shoot and did the concert, and then it was like Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday. I think it was Friday I said, “Look. I got to get back home, man, because I’m just wandering out here,” or at least it felt like it. I was being supervised. I got back to New Orleans. That’s where – I think it was during that summer, we went to the – my old violin teacher’s house, and I told…
the Louisiana Philharmonic. I had studied with him off and on through the years. In fact, he taught at Loyola University while I went to college.
